note: A segment that starts with the word total or subtotal. From the pilot (census_published.v2 LABEL_SEGMENT).
A segment that is exactly net assets. From the pilot (LABEL_SEGMENT).

A segment that is exactly an affiliation heading (controlled / non-controlled, affiliated / non-affiliated investments). From the pilot (CATEGORY_HEADING). A qualifier such as affiliated issuer does not match.

A segment that starts with cash and cash equivalents, at its start or after a comma. Pilot CASH_BUCKET matched the segment start only; the comma form is added for labels that put an entity name first.
Exception to r5_cash_bucket: a label naming a money-market fund is a cash position, not the cash bucket. From the pilot (r4_generic_cash_bucket). A row matching it is also marked is_cash (spec D7).
